The '''Rodian Salvager's Cartel''' was a criminal cartel of [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]] on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] led by [[Drexl Roosh]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], who had set up an impressive salvage operation on the junk-covered planet by using his minions to produce scrap and other goods that could be sold off-world. His scavengers would pick apart any junk found on the planet, looking for the valuable hunks of metal or intact mechanical parts. Drexl had little regard for the lives of his gang members and even less for the lives of those who attempted to interfere with his operations.

==History==
[[File:Drexl.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Drexl Roosh]] was the founder and leader of the [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]].]]
When the Rodian Salvage Cartel established its primary base of salvage operations on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] and came to control many areas on the surface. At some point, they came under assault from the insane [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kazdan Paratus]]'s [[Droid/Legends|droid]] legion of [[Scrap Guardian]]s, [[junk behemoth]]s, and [[Scrap Scavenger]]s. After initially suffering from heavy casualties, the gang managed to reorganize themselves and deploy their [[Heavy Defender]]s and [[Rodian Rippers]] against the [[Droid Army|droid army]].

When [[Galen Marek]] landed on the [[planet]], Heavy Defenders and Rodian Rippers were deployed on [[skiff]]s to stop him. Marek killed them along with the scavengers inside the wrecked [[hyperdrive]] core. Scavengers were also skirmishing with Paratus' droid army near a crashed [[blockade runner]], until Marek intervened and defeated both factions. Marek then advanced to the scavenger's camp, whereupon he destroyed its shield generator and fought his way past them into the junk chasm, into the territory of his target Kazdan Paratus, whom he killed.

Paratus' death allowed the scavengers a short-lived respite, but the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] soon descended onto the planet to claim it. The Empire and the cartel then skirmished over the planet until Galen Marek arrived again and defeated both parties, wiping out the criminal scavengers and killing Roosh.

==Variants==
*Rodian Heavy Defenders were relatively bulkier Rodians who wielded Z0-16 rotary cannons against anything that got in their way while salvaging the junk on Raxus Prime.
*Rodian Heavy Troopers were slim and lightly armored Rodians armed with [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]]. They accompanied other variants of the Cartel, providing long-range fire support against more heavily armored and dangerous opponents. They were effective at killing enemy targets from a distance, but were also vulnerable in close-range combat. Hence, they relied on the protection of their comrades.
*Rodian Rippers were relatively slimmer than the Heavy Defenders and wielded stun gloves containing knives along the fingers. These gloves also had an energy pad on the palms to allow them to pull junk towards them and, if necessary, launch it like a projectile at potential enemies they came across.

==Behind the Scenes==
[[Adam Nichols]] created concept design artwork of various members of the Cartel including Drexl Roosh for the [[Krome Studios]] port of the [[2008]] video game ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]].'' He even created concept design of a Salvager Cartel [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Low_Altitude_Assault_Transport/infantry/Legends LAAT/i] variant which went unused in the final game, as the cartel rather used a recycled & refurbished [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] LAAT/i. <ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.adamnichols.net/star_wars.php|text=Star Wars - The Force Unleashed|author=Adam Nichols|quote=Concept Design.|archivedate=20250405203411}}</ref>
